confidenceRules.Confirmed: Printing-specific price movement corroborated by reliable market or liquidity evidence.
confidenceRules.Developing: Real catalyst or deck demand with incomplete broad price/liquidity confirmation.
confidenceRules.Speculative: Spoiler, social, thin-listing, or anticipated-synergy thesis; not confirmed demand.

actionGuardrails.buyDiscipline: Prefer targeted singles, portable utility, and verified sealed value over random $50–$60 gift-box purchases.
actionGuardrails.dipRule: Use WAIT_FOR_DIP only when a dip, supply wave, sale volume, or market cooldown is independently visible; otherwise WATCH.
actionGuardrails.doNotChase: Do not promote a thin-listing spike, premium treatment, spoiler premium, or single-source percentage move to a buy call.
